# Attendance Grid

## Summary
Learners × live sessions; click cycles the mark, All present fills a column, Save writes the column through Mark Attendance; attendance % per learner.

## Usage
`<AttendanceGrid @cohort @enrollments @lessons @records @context @markedBy />`

## Non-goals
No QR check-in.

## Example
The linked cohort opens to the Attendance tab, which mounts this grid.
